history.reason: Critical Windows portability failure: code uses os.OpenRoot() without build tags, will not compile on Windows. Violates acceptance criterion 10.3-10.4 requiring platform-specific isolation for Unix-only assertions.
history.retraction_reason: Invalid finding. os.OpenRoot() is cross-platform in Go 1.22+. Iteration 1 verdict was based on factual error about API portability. Verified with pinned Go 1.26.1 toolchain: cross-compilation succeeds, Windows tests pass, PE32+ executable builds.

history.reason: All acceptance criteria met. Implementation correctly hardens permissions, prevents TOCTOU races, isolates Unix tests with build tags, and builds cross-platform. Iteration 1 finding rescinded.
